verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own repo says it provisions resources on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, and 300+ providers. Its docs say every language supports the full surface area of all Pulumi Registry providers, and it adds native Terraform/HCL support. Users independently report managing GCP and AWS (about 500 resources per deployment), DigitalOcean, and Kubernetes with it, though one user notes the Azure provider lagged behind Terraform's. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of named SaaS (non-cloud) providers, in-depth registry/provider documentation in the pack, and evidence that providers keep pace with upstream APIs.
